Title: General Availability: Multi-select delete in Azure Cosmos DB with Data Explorer

Body.Content:
We are excited to announce new deletion capabilities in the Data Explorer experience, making it easier and faster to delete items.  With the new multi-select capability, you can select multiple items to delete at the same time. You no longer need to open each item and click on the Delete button one at a time.  Gain efficiencies in database maintenance within Azure Cosmos DB Data Explorer with this new feature. 

Please be aware if you are using a legacy Azure Cosmos DB collection which does not have a partition key, the bulk delete feature is currently temporarily unavailable.  You may still delete items individually as needed.

Learn more.
